about: The quality test set (spec §64): representative requests with the behavior they must have. They run against the stub model in CI, where `stub` scripts what the model says, and against real models with TOSKAR_QUALITY_URL. Checks marked real_only need a real model's answer. Cases run on core unless `platforms` says otherwise; the iPhone app runs the ones marked "phone" through its on-device chat with the same expectations. `no_deflection` fails an answer that matches `deflection`, one that sends the person off to search or claims to browse, unless it also has the facts `answer_matches` asks for.
